{"reasoning": "To answer which sales channel accounted for the increase in North America revenue from October to November 2026, I need to:
1. Filter for North America region (region = 'NA')
2. Filter for October 2026 and November 2026 using orderedAt
3. Group by channel (partner, web) and month
4. Calculate revenue for each channel in each month
5. Compute the month-over-month change per channel
6. Identify which channel had the positive increase

I'll use Commerce.grossRevenue as the revenue measure since the question asks about 'revenue' generally. I'll also include Commerce.orderCount to understand the sample size behind the figures.", "query": {"measures": ["Commerce.grossRevenue", "Commerce.orderCount"], "dimensions": ["Commerce.channel", "Commerce.orderedAt"], "time_dimensions": [{"dimension": "Commerce.orderedAt", "granularity": "month", "date_range": ["2026-10-01", "2026-11-30"]}], "filters": [{"member": "Commerce.region", "operator": "equals", "values": ["NA"]}]}}
